item.name: Boss Waves
item.effect: All enemies are bosses.
item.counters: Shadow (Divine), 8th Sword (Berserk), Cursed Student (True Love), Puppet (Telekinetic)
item.cardSummary: Every enemy counts as a boss, so bring high single-target and boss-ready damage.

item.name: Cards Disabled
item.effect: Blood Money and Bounty Hunter Cards are disabled.
item.notes: Disables Blood Money and Bounty Hunter cards rather than changing enemy stats.
item.cardSummary: Blood Money and Bounty Hunter cards are turned off for the stage.

item.name: Mirror
item.effect: Enemies copy all units' elements as resistances.
item.notes: Element copy applies as resistances on enemies, so mono-element teams struggle.
item.cardSummary: Enemies gain resistances matching your units' elements, punishing mono-element teams.

item.name: No Anvils
item.effect: Stat Anvils are disabled.
item.notes: Turns off Stat Anvils for the stage; there is no unit counterpick.
item.cardSummary: Stat Anvils cannot be used, so plan around base unit stats and upgrades only.

item.name: No Farms
item.effect: Farm units are disabled.
item.notes: Blocks Farm unit deployment for the whole stage.
item.cardSummary: Farm units cannot be placed, forcing economy from other sources.

item.name: No Repair
item.effect: The Repair Hammer is disabled.
item.notes: Blocks the Repair Hammer for the stage.
item.cardSummary: The Repair Hammer is unavailable, so damaged setups stay damaged.

item.name: No Research Tree
item.effect: Research Tree Upgrades are disabled.
item.notes: Locks Research Tree upgrades for the stage.
item.cardSummary: Research Tree upgrades are locked for the run.

item.name: No Tomes
item.effect: Trait Tomes are disabled.
item.notes: Blocks Trait Tomes for the stage.
item.cardSummary: Trait Tomes cannot be used during the stage.

item.name: Resistance
item.effect: Resistances cycle from Flame > Hydro > Gale > Terra > Light > Storm > Dark every 30s.
item.counters: Bring multiple Elements such as Shadow (Dark), Flame Emperor (Flame), Elf Mage (Storm), Water Princess (Hydro), Lady Giant (Terra)
item.notes: Related to Enemy Resistances shown above enemies; cycle order is Flame → Hydro → Gale → Terra → Light → Storm → Dark.
item.cardSummary: Enemy elemental resistances rotate every 30 seconds through the full element cycle.

item.name: Shielded
item.effect: All enemies spawn with 10 shields.
item.cardSummary: All enemies spawn with ten shields, favoring shield-break and heavy DPS picks.

item.name: Short Range
item.effect: All ally units' ranges are decreased by -25%.
item.counters: Elf Mage (Unleashed), Shadow (Divine), String Demon (Awakened), Flame Emperor
item.cardSummary: Allied units lose 25% attack range, so favor naturally long-range damage.

item.name: Speedy
item.effect: Enemies are 50% faster.
item.counters: Puppet (Telekinetic), Toy Maker, Reaper (Released), True Saint (Holy)
item.cardSummary: Enemies move 50% faster, so crowd control and slows matter more than usual.

item.name: Traitless
item.effect: All traits are disabled.
item.notes: Unit traits do not apply while this stage rule is active.
item.cardSummary: Unit traits are disabled, so builds rely on base kits and equipment.

item.name: Upgrade Cap
item.effect: Only 25 upgrades are allowed across all units.
item.cardSummary: The team can buy only 25 total unit upgrades for the whole stage.

item.name: Sprinter
item.effect: Moves 45% faster but has 20% less health.
item.cardSummary: Fast, lower-HP enemy that rushes lanes and needs slows or early damage.

item.name: Tank
item.effect: Moves 20% slower but has 20% increased health.
item.cardSummary: Slower enemy with extra health that soaks damage and stalls fights.

item.name: Summoner
item.effect: Every 5 seconds, summons enemies at its location (up to 5 enemies).
item.cardSummary: Periodically spawns extra enemies at its position until removed.

item.name: Explosive
item.effect: On death, explodes in a 10 range radius and stuns units for 2 seconds.
item.counters: Long-range Units like Elf Mage (Unleashed) and Shadow (Divine)
item.cardSummary: Dies into a short stun blast, so keep key units out of the explosion radius.

item.name: Splitter
item.effect: On death, splits into 3 enemies, each having 33% of its health.
item.cardSummary: Splits into three weaker enemies on death, multiplying pressure if ignored.

item.name: Armored
item.effect: Takes 33% less damage from full AoE attacks.
item.cardSummary: Takes much less damage from full AoE attacks, so mix in focused damage.

item.name: Reinforced
item.effect: Takes 30% less damage from all sources.
item.cardSummary: Takes 30% less damage from every source and needs sustained high DPS.

item.name: Regen I
item.effect: Regenerates 1% maximum health per second.
item.cardSummary: Slow self-heal at 1% max HP per second.

item.name: Regen II
item.effect: Regenerates 3% maximum health per second.
item.cardSummary: Moderate self-heal at 3% max HP per second.

item.name: Regen III
item.effect: Regenerates 5% maximum health per second.
item.cardSummary: Strong self-heal at 5% max HP per second.

item.name: Regen IV
item.effect: Regenerates 8% maximum health per second.
item.cardSummary: Very strong self-heal at 8% max HP per second; burn it down quickly.

item.name: Shield
item.effect: Protected by an attack-absorbing shield.
item.cardSummary: Carries an attack-absorbing shield until broken.

item.name: Immunity
item.effect: Immune to all soft and hard crowd control effects.
item.cardSummary: Cannot be affected by soft or hard crowd control.

item.name: Momentum
item.effect: Gains 2% movement speed per second up to a maximum of 50%.
item.cardSummary: Ramps movement speed over time up to a large bonus if left free.

item.name: Burrowing
item.effect: Every 8 seconds, burrows underground for 2 seconds, becoming untargetable.
item.cardSummary: Briefly becomes untargetable on a short burrow cycle.

item.name: Zombie
item.effect: On death, revives with 50% health, and drops 50% less Yen when killed.
item.cardSummary: Revives once at half health and pays less Yen on kill.

item.name: Zombify
item.effect: Periodically converts nearby enemies within 10 range into zombified enemies.
item.cardSummary: Turns nearby enemies into Zombified copies over time.

item.name: Zombified
item.effect: Revived enemy that drops no Yen when killed.
item.counters: Any strong AoE Unit, such as String Demon (Awakened) or Hollow (Blaze)
item.notes: Usually created by Zombie or Zombify rather than spawning as a primary tag alone.
item.cardSummary: Revived enemy form that drops no Yen when killed.

item.name: Commander
item.effect: Grants nearby enemies within 5 range +20% movement speed and +20% health.
item.cardSummary: Buffs nearby enemies with more speed and health.

item.name: Research Project
item.effect: Grants progress towards your active Expedition Project.
item.counters: Any high-DPS Unit to eliminate it quickly.
item.notes: A beneficial enemy tag that advances your Expedition Project when handled.
item.cardSummary: Killing or handling it advances your active Expedition Project.

item.name: Soldier
item.effect: Gains +20% movement speed while near a Commander.
item.notes: Speed bonus only applies while a Commander is nearby.
item.cardSummary: Gains a movement speed bonus while near a Commander.

item.name: Veil
item.effect: Grants a 200% damage-absorbing AoE shield based on the host's health to all nearby enemies within 5 range.
item.cardSummary: Gives nearby enemies a large damage-absorbing AoE shield tied to the host.

item.name: Tartaros
item.effect: Every 10 seconds, consume a nearby Basic enemy and gain "Regen I" for 10 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Eats a nearby Basic enemy for temporary Regen I.

item.name: Death
item.effect: Grants nearby enemies a stacking +20% permanent speed boost. Applying soft cc will reset the stack to zero.
item.notes: Soft crowd control clears the stacking speed buff.
item.cardSummary: Stacks permanent speed on nearby enemies until soft CC resets it.

item.name: Sword
item.effect: Respawns up to 2 times unless killed while affected by a DoT effect.
item.notes: DoT-based kills prevent the extra respawns.
item.cardSummary: Can respawn twice unless finished while under a DoT.

item.name: Dawn
item.effect: Enemies spawned by Splitter or Summoner have 99% reduced health and 5 Shield.
item.notes: Changes enemies spawned by Splitter or Summoner specifically.
item.cardSummary: Splitter and Summoner spawns become frail but start with five shields.

item.name: Stunner
item.effect: Every 15 seconds, stuns the 3 nearest units for 5 seconds.
item.counters: Elf Mage (Unleashed), Shadow (Divine), spread out your Unit placements.
item.cardSummary: Periodically stuns the three nearest units for a long lockout.

item.name: Zone Debuff
item.effect: Applies a debuff within a specific area.
item.counters: Long-range Units and strategic Unit placement.
item.notes: All listed sources only say a debuff applies in an area; the exact debuff name is not documented.
item.cardSummary: Applies an unspecified debuff in a local area around the tagged enemy.

item.name: Transformer
item.effect: At 50% health, transforms into a second phase at full health.
item.cardSummary: At half health, shifts into a second full-health phase.

item.name: Bulwark
item.effect: Every 10 seconds, becomes immune to damage for 3 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Briefly becomes damage-immune on a repeating timer.

item.name: Status Cleanse
item.effect: Every 10 seconds, removes all crowd control effects from enemies on the map.
item.cardSummary: Periodically strips crowd control from enemies across the map.

item.name: Retaliation Counter
item.effect: After every 20 hits, stuns all units for 2 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Every 20 hits, stuns every unit for two seconds.

item.name: Greed
item.effect: Every 10 seconds, steal 10% HP of all nearby enemies within 5 range.
item.notes: Steals HP from nearby enemies into the host; focus the tagged enemy to stop the steal loop.
item.cardSummary: Steals HP from nearby enemies on a short timer to keep itself topped up.

item.name: Cage
item.effect: Pick a random unit on the field, and cage them, disabling their attacks, passives and abilities.
item.counters: Bring multiple DPS Units instead of relying on a single carry.
item.notes: Single-carry comps are risky because a random unit can be fully disabled.
item.cardSummary: Randomly cages a unit and shuts off its attacks, passives, and abilities.

item.name: Fear
item.effect: Every 15 seconds, decrease DMG/SPA/RNG by -10% to all units within 30 range for 10 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Periodically weakens nearby units' damage, SPA, and range.

item.name: Warlock
item.effect: Grants +1 Shield and +10% speed boost to surrounding enemies every 5 seconds within 10 range.
item.cardSummary: Keeps buffing nearby enemies with shields and speed on a short cycle.
